harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The clause «فأنذر» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «قم».

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: The fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida); «ربَّك» is the fronted object of «كبر»; the clause «كَبِّر» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «أنذر».

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The clause «ولا تمنن» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «اهجر», and the clause «تستكثر» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of «تمنن».

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: The fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida); the preposition phrase «لربك» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «اصبر».

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The conditional clause is resumptive; the preposition phrase is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); «إذا» is adverbial and conditional, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the meaning of the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), i.e.: when the Trumpet is sounded, the matter becomes hard.

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: «يومئذ» is a badal (substitute) from «فذلك», and it is made indeclinable because it is annexed to an indeclinable word; «إذٍ» is an adverbial noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the tanwīn is for compensation. His words «عسير»: a naʿt (adjective) of «يوم».

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: «غير» is a second naʿt (adjective) of «يوم»; the preposition phrase «على الكافرين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) {عَسِيرٌ}.

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The clause «ذرني» is resumptive; «من» is a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the yāʾ; «وحيدا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the implied (muqaddar) pronoun in «خلقت», i.e.: I created him alone.

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: The preposition phrase «له» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the second object.

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: The maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن أزيد» is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e.: for increase (في الزيادة).

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: The preposition phrase «لآياتنا» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عنيدا», which includes the meaning of «جاحدا» (denying).

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The clause «سأرهقه» is resumptive; «صعودا» is tamyīz (specification).

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The clause «فقتل» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause «إنه فكر»; «كيف» is an interrogative noun, a ḥāl (circumstantial); the clause «قدَّر» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: (ثم قتل كيف قدر) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding one.

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: The clause «يؤثر» is a naʿt (adjective) of «سحر».

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: (إن هذا إلا قول البشر) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: «سقر» is a second object, and the clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: The clause «وما أدراك» is parenthetical between the ḥāl (circumstantial) clause and the one possessing it, «سقر»; the clause «ما سقر» is the object of «أدراك», suspended by the interrogative.

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The clause «لا تبقي» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the first «سقر».

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: «لواحة» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: it is scorching (هي لواحة), and the clause is a second ḥāl (circumstantial) from the first «سقر».

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: «تسعة عشر» are two parts, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is a third ḥāl (circumstantial).

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: The clause «وما جعلنا» is resumptive; «إلا» is for restriction (ḥaṣr); «ملائكة» is a second object; the preposition phrase «للذين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «فتنة»; the genitive maṣdar (verbal noun) «ليستيقن» is attached to the second «جعل»; «إيمانا» is tamyīz (specification); «ما» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject); «ذا» is a relative noun, the khabar (predicate); «مثلا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the demonstrative; the clause «يضل» is resumptive, and the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e.: Allah leads astray with a leading astray like that leading astray; the clause «وما يعلم» is resumptive; «هو» is the fāʿil (agent) of «يعلم»; and likewise «وما هي إلا ذكرى» [is resumptive]; the preposition phrase «للبشر» is attached to a naʿt of «ذكرى».

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: «والقمر»: the wāw is for the oath, and the thing sworn by is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied (muqaddar) verb «أقسم» (I swear).

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The adverb «إذ» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb «أقسم».

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: «إذا» is a pure adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb «أقسم».

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: (إنها لإحدى الكبر) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The answer to the oath.

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: «نذيرا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «إحدى»; the preposition phrase «للبشر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نذيرا».

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: The preposition phrase «لمن» is a badal (substitute) from «البشر»; the preposition phrase «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «مَنْ»; and the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يتقدم» is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of «شاء».

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: «ما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «رهينة».

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: The preposition phrase «في جنات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the wāw in «يتساءلون».

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The clause «ما سلككم» is explicative of the asking.

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: «نَكُ» is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) with the sukūn implied (muqaddar) on the nūn that was omitted for lightness.

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: The interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) (أن أتانا) is genitive by «حتى», attached to (mutaʿalliq) «نكذب».

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: (فما تنفعهم شفاعة الشافعين) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: The clause «فما لهم» is resumptive; «ما» is an interrogative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition phrase «لهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the preposition phrase «عن التذكرة» is attached to «مُعْرضين», the ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in «لهم».

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: (كأنهم حمر مستنفرة) [Translator's note: phrase discussed] The clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in {مُعْرِضِينَ}.

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: The clause «فَرَّتْ» is a second naʿt (adjective) of {حُمُرٌ}.

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The clause «يريد» is resumptive; the preposition phrase «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «كل»; the maṣdar (verbal noun) «أن يؤتى» is the object of «يريد»; «صحفا» is the second object of «يؤتى».

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The clause «فمن شاء» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the clause {إِنَّهُ تَذْكِرَةٌ}; «من» is a conditional noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject).

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: The clause «وما يذكرون» is resumptive; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) is accusative by removal of the preposition, the bāʾ; and the clause «هو أهل» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) clause from the Divine Name.
